preview.overview: BYU travels to Lawrence as the belt holder, having claimed the lineal championship with a 28-24 win over Notre Dame. Kansas has owned this matchup historically, winning three straight meetings dating back to 1992, including a 17-13 victory just last season. The belt stays with BYU or returns to Kansas for the first time since 2024.
key_matchups: BYU's ability to protect the ball after losing 39-31 to UCF against a Kansas defense that just fell 35-24 to Kansas State
Kansas's ground game and clock control against a BYU team that has shown vulnerability on the road (losses at Utah and UCF in recent weeks)
BYU's recent momentum from beating Notre Dame versus Kansas's inconsistency, with three losses in their last five games
preview.betting_angles: Kansas owns the head-to-head series 3-0 since 1992, most recently winning 17-13 in 2024, suggesting the Jayhawks match up well with BYU. However, BYU's current form is notably stronger—they're 3-2 in their last five with a win over a Power conference opponent in Notre Dame, while Kansas is 2-3 in the same span. The Cougars' recent road losses at Utah and UCF show vulnerability away from home, which could favor Kansas at Arrowhead.
preview.prediction_writeup: Despite Kansas's historical dominance in this series and home-field advantage, BYU's belt comes away intact in a close contest. The Cougars have shown resilience in defending the title with three wins in five games, including an impressive 28-24 victory over Notre Dame that demonstrates they can win tight games against ranked competition. Kansas has struggled with consistency, dropping three of its last five, and while their 25-24 win over Baylor shows they can compete, they haven't shown the same caliber of opponent success that BYU has. BYU's recent road losses were to Utah and UCF—both programs with stronger offenses—and Kansas's defense allowing 35 to Kansas State is concerning. In a matchup where Kansas historically wins but BYU currently plays better, the belt holder's slight edge in form tips this close game to the Cougars.
